description: The Libraries, Audit and Settings tabs on Access Roles' dashboard page in the TV layout (localStorage 'layout' = 'tv'), as admin, reading only, with the Libraries tab remembered from an earlier visit (kit storage jfar:adminTab), which the page opens on: every tab, library card and audit line has tabindex 0 (the D-pad's to reach), ArrowDown moves the focus on from a card, OK opens the Audit and Settings tabs, OK on Review opens the settings review (its dry run) with the focus inside, Backspace (a Hisense remote's Back) closes it with the focus back on Review, and nothing is saved; Undo leaves no change. accessroles-admin-tabs-probe.mjs --webcheck runs it.

steps.name: the TV layout, and the Libraries tab remembered from an earlier visit
the module mounted: the tabs, the status loaded, the chips, the loading note hidden
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#AccessRolesConfigPage:not(.hide)'); return !!p && p.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]').length === 8 && p.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesStatus table').length === 5 && p.querySelector('#AccessRolesScriptNote').hidden === true && p.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesChips [data-chip]').length >= 10; })()

steps.name: the check's helpers
the page opened on the remembered Libraries tab
every tab in the D-pad's reach
every card in the D-pad's reach
the focus on the first card
the D-pad moved the focus on, inside the tab
the focus on the Audit tab
every audit line in the D-pad's reach
the focus on the Settings tab
the review, the focus inside it
Back (Backspace on a TV remote) closes it
closed, the focus back on Review
no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
